name: Intra Golflink Resorts Tbk.
summary: Established in 2005 with its headquarters in Bogor, Indonesia, PT Intra GolfLink Resorts Tbk primarily specializes in the creation and operation of golf courses throughout Indonesia. The company's business activities also encompass restoration initiatives, real estate ventures, and partnerships in land management. It operates as a subsidiary of PT Bali Pecatu Graha.
